contentSections: Quick answer

A facade warranty is a written promise from the supplier about how the facade will perform for a set number of years. In most metal facade projects there are two separate warranties: a finish warranty, which covers colour and coating performance, and a structural warranty, which covers the fixing system. Metaguise provides both in writing at handover. Always read the conditions, exclusions and claim process, because the headline number alone tells you very little.
Key takeaways

• A warranty is only as good as its conditions. Ask for the document before you sign. • Finish and fixing warranties are different. Ask for each. • PVDF coatings typically carry longer warranties than powder coat. • Cleaning and inspection are usually conditions of the warranty, so keep records.
The two warranties you should ask for
1. Finish warranty

This covers the coating or finish: fading, chalking, peeling or loss of adhesion within defined limits. For PVDF coatings, a 25+ year warranty is standard for colour retention in the market and is described in our guide to PVDF vs powder coat, where PVDF meets the AAMA 2605 standard. Powder coat typically meets AAMA 2604 and carries a 10 to 15 year warranty. Metaguise issues a finish warranty aligned with the AAMA 2605 standard for colour retention.
2. Structural warranty on the fixing system

This covers the sub-frame, brackets and fixings that hold panels to the building. It matters because a failed fixing is a safety problem, not only a cosmetic one. Ask which parts are covered and for how long.
What a good facade warranty document should say

ItemWhat to look for
CoverageWhich parts: coating, panels, fixings, sealants
DurationYears for each part, not one number for everything
StandardNamed test standard for the finish, such as AAMA 2605
LimitsFade or chalk limits written as measurable values
ConditionsCleaning schedule, inspection, no alteration
ExclusionsDamage from impact, misuse, extreme exposure
ClaimsWho to contact, how, and how fast
TransferWhether it passes to a new owner
DeliveryProvided in writing at handover
Typical exclusions and conditions

Warranties often exclude damage from impact, vandalism, harsh chemical cleaners, modifications by others, and exposure beyond the agreed specification, such as a coastal site treated as inland. Many require regular cleaning. Our facade maintenance guide lists cleaning schedules by climate, including a minimum of two washes a year in composite climates and more frequent fresh-water rinsing near the sea.
How warranty links to the choice of finish

A longer warranty is useful only if the finish deserves it. PVDF is built for strong UV and weather performance. Powder coat is economical and suits many projects. Metaguise lists 15 to 30 year coating warranties across PVDF, anodised and powder coat finishes, depending on the system and specification. Check the exact term for your project in writing. For a wider look at finishes, read the MetaSurface finish guide.
If you want a low maintenance facade, the warranty and the finish should be chosen together. Our article on low maintenance metal facades explains why.
Questions to ask every facade company

1. Can I see the warranty document today, before I sign the contract? 2. What does the finish warranty cover, and for how many years? 3. What does the structural warranty cover? 4. What cleaning and inspection do you require, and who does it? 5. What is excluded? 6. How do I make a claim, and who responds? 7. Is the warranty backed by the coating maker, the facade company, or both?
For more checks before you hire, see our guide to choosing a facade company in India, which includes reading the warranty before you sign.
Warranty and price: why cheap quotes can hide weaker cover

Lower quotations may use thinner sheet or weaker coatings, or exclude items such as scaffolding and sealants. A short or vague warranty is often a sign of the same trade-offs. Compare the warranty line by line, along with the specification, when you compare prices. Our guide to metal facade cost explains what belongs in a facade quotation.
Frequently asked questions

1. What is a facade warranty?

It is a written promise from the supplier that the facade finish or fixings will perform for a stated number of years under stated conditions.

2. How long is a facade warranty in India?

It varies by finish and supplier. PVDF coatings commonly carry 25+ years for colour retention, while powder coat typically carries 10 to 15 years. Always check the written terms.

3. Does the warranty cover the fixings and sub-frame?

Only if it says so. Ask for a structural warranty on the fixing system, in writing.

4. What can void a facade warranty?

Typically harsh cleaning chemicals, impact damage, unapproved alterations, and ignoring required cleaning or inspection.

5. Is a long warranty a guarantee of quality?

No. It shows confidence, but the conditions, exclusions and the supplier’s ability to honour it matter just as much.

6. Does Metaguise provide a written warranty?

Yes. Finish and structural warranties are provided in writing at handover.
